name: Los Altos Community Services Volunteers
org: City of Los Altos, Community Services
what_you_do: Help at city events like Family Fun Days, the Spring Egg Hunt, and summer concerts, or help at the Adult 50+ Program with luncheons, coffee, setup, and games.
who_can_apply: Anyone at least 14. Volunteers under 18 need a parental permission form. The city takes individuals, groups, and families, one time or ongoing.
duration: One-time or ongoing shifts. Adult 50+ Program hours are weekdays, 9 a.m. to 2 p.m.
deadline_text: The city is accepting applications now. No deadline is listed.
how_to_apply: Download and fill out the volunteer application. Return it in person at the Los Altos Community Center (97 Hillview Ave), by email to rec-info@losaltosca.gov, by mail, or by fax. Staff will contact you with next steps. Questions: Bridget Matheson, bmatheson@losaltosca.gov.
notes: The city's Teen Programs page points teens ages 14 to 18 to this volunteer page. The free Teen Center (grades 6 to 12, weekdays 3 to 6 p.m., Los Altos Community Center) is a drop-in space, not a volunteer role.
